title: Calibrated-coefficient writeback into atomic registries with provenance (closes L6->L1 NN loop)
brief: The 7-layer NN model demands backprop from L6 (learning) into L1 (atomic registries). MS18 trains LoRA adapters; MS10 calibrates predictions. But neither writes the calibrated kc/Taylor/Johnson-Cook coefficients BACK to FormulaRegistry/MaterialRegistry. This MS closes that loop with provenance + rollback. Architect Gap #4. Critical path.

units.title: Define CalibrationProvenance schema + atomic-write contract
exit_conditions: schema versioned: {coefId, oldValue, newValue, jobId, sampleN, confidenceBand, source, ts, schemaVersion}
every registry write requires provenance object
tests: schema validation 3 happy + 3 fail (missing field, NaN sample, future ts)
units.description: No untagged writes. Every coefficient change carries traceable audit.

units.title: BackpropRegistryEngine: write to FormulaRegistry/MaterialRegistry with delta + journal
exit_conditions: engine writes calibrated kc/Taylor/Johnson-Cook coefficients to canonical registries
old value journaled to backprop-journal.jsonl before each write
tests: 5 happy writes + 2 invariant violations (out-of-range coefficient blocked)
units.description: Connect MS10 calibration output to L1 registries. Reuses physics/constants.ts as canonical source; writes update the in-memory registry mirror first, then atomic-write to disk.

units.title: Rollback path with monotonic regression test
exit_conditions: rollback restores any prior coefficient from journal
monotonic regression: rolling 50-job MAPE never increases by >5% post-write (else auto-rollback)
tests: 1 known-bad calibration triggers auto-rollback within 1 cycle
units.description: Risk auditor flagged this as a tech-debt bomb (will ship without monotonic test under deadline). Build the test FIRST; rollback validates against it.

acceptance: calibrated kc/Taylor/Johnson-Cook coefficients written back to FormulaRegistry/MaterialRegistry with provenance (job_id, sample_n, confidence_band); rollback path verified with 1 known-bad calibration triggering auto-rollback; monotonic regression test green; closes L6->L1 NN backprop loop.

risks.description: Bad calibration silently degrades all downstream pipelines; mitigation = monotonic regression auto-rollback + 24h shadow mode before live writes
Journal grows unbounded; mitigation = compaction every 10K entries with snapshot anchor
Concurrent writes from multiple chats; mitigation = registry write-lock via prism_context:claim_file with 30s TTL
